result.instructions: Tools for Heymarket, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations in our inboxes are unread?"; "Find the contact with the phone number 14155551234 and show their recent messages."; "List the lists and tags our team uses for broadcasts.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Heymarket data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run heymarket_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run heymarket_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run heymarket_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. heymarket_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: heymarket_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Show the Heymarket team that the API Secret belongs to, with its members. Use it first to check the connection. Heymarket API: GET /v1/team.

tools.name: heymarket_list_inboxes
tools.title: List inboxes
tools.description: List the team's inboxes (the phone numbers messages send from) and their members. Use the inbox id and a member id in send calls. Heymarket API: GET /v1/inboxes.

tools.name: heymarket_find_team_members
tools.title: Find team members
tools.description: Find team members by phone number or email address, with their memberships. Heymarket API: POST /v1/users/get.

phone.description: Phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign.

tools.name: heymarket_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by a channel value such as a phone number or email address. Heymarket API: POST /v2/contacts/search.

channel_type.description: Channel type to search in, for example phone or email. Omit to detect it from the value.

channel_ids.description: Channel values to match, for example phone numbers in E.164 format.

tools.name: heymarket_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Page through the team's contacts, most recently updated first. Pass `date` to list only contacts updated since that time. Heymarket API: POST /v2/contacts/list.

date.description: Return contacts updated since this RFC 3339 timestamp.

tools.name: heymarket_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its UUID, with its channels, tags and custom fields. Heymarket API: GET /v2/contact/{contactID}.

tools.name: heymarket_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: Page through conversations. Filter by inbox, open or closed state, unread, or unanswered. Heymarket API: POST /v1/conversations.

inboxes.description: Only conversations in these inbox ids.

closed.description: true for closed conversations, false for open ones.

unanswered.description: true for conversations with no reply yet.

tools.name: heymarket_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by its integer id. Heymarket API: GET /v1/conversations/{id}.

tools.name: heymarket_get_message_history
tools.title: Get message history
tools.description: Get the message history of one phone number in one inbox, from an optional timestamp. Heymarket API: GET /v1/messages.

phone_number.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id that the conversation belongs to.

timestamp.description: Return messages from this RFC 3339 timestamp on.

tools.name: heymarket_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: Page through the team's messages, newest first. For the next page, pass `created_at` of the last message received. History covers the last 12 months. Heymarket API: POST /v1/messages/all.

created_at.description: Last returned message timestamp (RFC 3339). Omit for the newest messages.

inbox_id.description: Only messages from this inbox id.

tools.name: heymarket_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: Page through the team's contact lists, most recently updated first. Heymarket API: POST /v2/lists/paginate.

tools.name: heymarket_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: Page through the team's contact tags. Heymarket API: POST /v1/tags.

tools.name: heymarket_list_templates
tools.title: List message templates
tools.description: Page through the team's saved message templates. Heymarket API: POST /v1/templates.

tools.name: heymarket_send_message
tools.title: Send SMS or MMS
tools.description: Send one SMS or MMS now from an inbox to one phone number or one existing chat. A sent message cannot be recalled. Send only to people who consented to messages. Heymarket API: POST /v1/message/send.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id to send from (see heymarket_list_inboxes).

phone_number.description: Recipient in E.164 format without the plus sign, for example 14155553434. Give this or chat_id.

chat_id.description: Existing chat id to send to. Give this or phone_number.

media_url.description: Public URL of a picture or file to send as MMS.

signature_mode.description: user (default) signs with the sender's name. ai_agent signs as the AI agent. Never say the text was written by a person when an AI wrote it.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Heymarket
prompts.description: What you can do with Heymarket here, with example requests to try.
